query: What draft IRB language, consent scripts, and privacy/data‑handling protocols are required for human‑mediated multimodal grounding experiments?

response.query: What draft IRB language, consent scripts, and privacy/data‑handling protocols are required for human‑mediated multimodal grounding experiments?
response.answer: For human-mediated multimodal grounding experiments, IRB requires clear consent scripts explaining study details, data privacy protocols, and assurance of data confidentiality. Participants must agree to data use and understand their right to withdraw. Ensure compliance with HIPAA and relevant data protection laws.

results.title: Transduction of the Geomagnetic Field as Evidenced from alpha ...
results.content: Alpha-ERD in response to the geomagnetic field was triggered only by horizontal rotations when the static vertical magnetic field was directed downwards, as it is in the Northern Hemisphere; no brain responses were elicited by the same horizontal rotations when the static vertical component was directed upwards. The neural response was also sensitive to the polarity of the magnetic field. We found two classes of ecologically-relevant rotations of Earth-strength magnetic fields that produce strong, specific and repeatable effects on human brainwave activity in the electroencephalography (EEG) alpha-band (8–13 Hz); EEG discriminates in response to different geomagnetic field stimuli. The magnetic map is a more complex response involving various components of field intensity and direction; direction is further subdivided into inclination (vertical angle from the horizontal plane; the North-seeking vector of the geomagnetic field dips downwards in the Northern Hemisphere) and declination (clockwise angle of the horizontal component from Geographic North, as in a man-made compass).
